scope: Negative compiler-selection experiment for an interim engine source; not a complete module or executable proof. Fixup equivalence was not used as a separate gate here.
source_note: Private interim candidate, with older sprite/map sorting and the common wall visibility tail restored. Later source iterations may differ.

patch_10_5a.method: Apply PTCH25.A to a private copy of the 10.5 compiler with the original BINW/bpatch.exe -b -p. Retain original 10.5 headers and W32RUN.EXE.

input_replay.command: Export src/engine/engine.c, src/engine/include and src/cache/include from git revision 2b35669 to build/engine-compiler-replay/base, then run: patch -o build/engine-compiler-replay/engine.c build/engine-compiler-replay/base/src/engine/engine.c evidence/engine-compiler-input.patch
input_replay.compile_recipe: Use profiles/watcom/tools/runner.py compile_source(home, replay_source, output, ["/4r","/s","/or"], 60, include_dirs=[Path("build/engine-compiler-replay/base/src/engine/include"), Path("build/engine-compiler-replay/base/src/cache/include")]) for each compiler home. Compare all parsed OMF segment names, classes, sizes, attributes and data bytes with the 10.5 baseline.
